title: The Backbone Clue
intro: This quiz follows Asha and Ben as they learn how animals are grouped into vertebrates and invertebrates.

choices: An animal that lives only in water
questions.explanation: A vertebrate is an animal with a backbone.

questions.prompt: What are the small bones that make up the backbone called?
questions.explanation: The small bones that make up the backbone are called vertebrae.

choices: Fish, amphibians, reptiles, birds, and mammals
Jellyfish, sea stars, crabs, and octopuses
questions.explanation: Fish, amphibians, reptiles, birds, and mammals are all vertebrates.

questions.prompt: Which animal in the story is an invertebrate?
What clue did Asha and Ben use to classify the animals?
choices: Whether the animal had a backbone
questions.explanation: Asha and Ben classified the animals by whether they had a backbone.
